count_back.name: Count back
count_back.how: Step back one at a time from the bigger number.

count_up.name: Count up
count_up.how: Start at the smaller number and count on to the bigger one.

bridge_ten.name: Bridge through ten
bridge_ten.how: Jump back to the nearest ten, then take the rest.

constant_difference.name: Keep the same difference
constant_difference.how: Slide both numbers up until the smaller one is a ten.

compensate.name: Subtract a friendly number
compensate.how: Take a whole ten, then give the extra back.

place_value_jumps.name: Take the tens, then the ones
place_value_jumps.how: Split the part by place and jump twice.

written_column.name: Write it in columns
written_column.how: Set it out by place and exchange where you need to.
